data: Large marble plaque, broken into multiple pieces and restored; part of left margin lost.

Fine to medium-grained, veined and banded, white, calcitic, smelly marble, likely Parian-1, Parian-2, Proconnesian. Optical microscopy: homeoblastic to heteroblastic fabric. Digital microscopy: heteroblastic to homeoblastic fabric (identification based on digital microscopy, XRD, optical microscopy, stable isotopes analysis)
Honours Iulia Mamea, mother of Severus Alexander
I.Sicily with the permission of the Assessorato Regionale dei Beni Culturali e dell’Identità Siciliana - Dipartimento dei Beni Culturali e dell’Identità Siciliana; photo J. Prag 2022-05-23
Partially reopened following extensive restoration work. Comprehensive collection of archaeological material, predominantly from the West of the island, with an important Etruscan collection.
Centre of Palermo, Piazza Olivella 24, 90100 - Palermo
